reasoning: The plant shows reddish-brown discoloration of the lower stem with the surrounding field exhibiting premature death/desiccation. This stem base discoloration combined with field-wide early senescence is characteristic of Sudden Death Syndrome (Fusarium virguliforme), which causes root rot, stem discoloration, and premature plant death. Brown Stem Rot is a close differential but typically lacks the external reddish stem coloration seen here.
